notes: LUMENFALL is a complete single-file canvas action game: a lantern spirit survives escalating waves of crystalline enemies, collecting motes of light, chaining combos, dashing through danger and unleashing a screen-clearing Nova. All art is drawn procedurally on canvas and all music and sound effects are synthesized with Web Audio. Includes title, pause, game-over and restart flows, persistent high score, mouse and keyboard controls, and touch controls. Known limitation: the game is tuned for desktop and landscape play; touch firing is automatic and the arena is best experienced on a wider screen.
